eve (solutions): heads up — AcroSys just asked to onboard Cedar-14B for their private deployment. They want 8k context, int8 quant preferred, and deterministic outputs for compliance. Can we triage?
cheng (ml): copying checklist items: model format? tokenizer compat? pos emb type? long-context support? also need sample prompt set for regressions.
eve (solutions): model artifacts are on a presigned S3 link, safetensors, HF tokenizer. I'll DM the link. customer says latency target ~120ms/token at p50 and they expect bursty traffic.
priya (quant): int8 is fine but need to know activation ranges and grouping. Any custom attention kernels (rotary/rope)? that affects quant path.
sam (eval): we'll need eval suites: MMLU subset, TruthfulQA short, a few in-house prompt families, and the customer's 200 prompt regression set. Who can get that?
eve (solutions): I'll request their regression set and a short list of critical responses.
cheng (ml): quick smoke plan: 1) verify model loads in runtime 2) run fp16 perf baseline 3) run int8 quantize (GPTQ-ish) 4) compare perplexity and key metrics 5) run 8k KV cache sanity.
priya (quant): I can run GPTQ-style quant on a dev GPU pool. Need a 2GB calibration sample (we have a script). Can someone spin a job?
kai (infra-bot): dev-gpu-pool has 2xA100s free in zone-us-west1 for next 3 hours. Use job ID: dev-3087.
noah (platform): watch out for memory blowup with 8k context; estimate: ~24GB VRAM for 1x batch at 8k fp16, but with int8 we can push more. We'll test batching later.
eve (solutions): customer expects a canary in their dedicated cluster next week. Is that realistic?
cheng (ml): timeline check: smoke quant + basic eval in 48h if artifacts stable. Canary on dedicated depends on infra slot—noah?
noah (platform): core: we need to validate model signature (tokenizer id, eos token) and ensure model sharding works with our runtime. If that passes, we can schedule canary Tue/Wed.
priya (quant): blockers: 1) position embedding type — if it's RoPE we need to ensure our RoPE quant kernels are compatible; 2) fused QKV layout oddities — if weight layout is not standard, quant tools may fail.
cheng (ml): can you run a quick inspect and paste the first few model config keys?
eve (solutions): pasted config from customer:\n```\n{"model_type": "causal_lm", "hidden_size": 8192, "num_attention_heads": 64, "rotary_pct": 1.0, "max_position_embeddings": 8192, "torch_dtype": "float16", "vocab_size": 50288}\n```
priya (quant): rotary_pct=1.0 -> RoPE full support. Good. I'll kick off calibration -> job dev-3087 and post logs.
sam (eval): I'll queue the eval harness: run mmlu-5k, truthqa-short, rouge for summarization tests, and the customer's 200-regression. Tagging thresholds: no more than 3% drop vs FP16 on key metrics, and deterministic match rate >= 95% for their regression set.
eve (solutions): customer also asked about fallbacks if int8 quality regresses. We should propose a policy: prefer int8 by default, fall back to fp16 for flagged prompts or on quality alerts.
cheng (ml): agree. Also add an A/B rollout with 5% traffic to start. We'll need rollout config in console.
noah (platform): I'll reserve a dedicated slot for canary and add tracing hooks. Need the model artifact hash for deployment.
priya (quant): started quant job — logs: "calibration samples loaded (2.1GB), analyzing ranges..." will post perf numbers when done.
priya (quant): perf sneak peek: fp16 single-token latency p50 ~150ms on A100 with 8k KV (single stream). Int8 preview shows ~95ms p50. Accuracy regression preliminary: ~1.8% on our small mmlu probe.
sam (eval): nice. schedule full runs — ETA 10h.
eve (solutions): action items: eve will get regression set (owner: eve), priya runs quant (owner: priya), cheng does bring-up + sanity (owner: cheng), sam runs eval (owner: sam), noah reserves canary slot (owner: noah).
eve (solutions): tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Thanks all :thumbsup:
cheng (ml): adding to the intake spreadsheet under "pending canary" with priority high (customer SLA).
noah (platform): FYI: if quantified model passes, we'll add a cached prefix config to speed repeated prompts.
priya (quant): will also try grouped-gemmlowp quant variant if GPTQ quality drops below threshold.
sam (eval): will emit a comparison report once full runs finish.
eve (solutions): thanks — will update customer with expected canary next Wed and share progress.
noah (platform): marking thread resolved when canary is scheduled.
priya (quant): log update (last): "quant job dev-3087 complete, artifacts at s3://redwood-temp/cedar14b/int8-gptq-v1/"
sam (eval): final note: if any large quality regressions show up, we should plan a rollback to fp16 and schedule root-cause triage.
eve (solutions): noted. closing loop after eval report. :white_check_mark:
